observation.visible_scene: A small jungle waterfall cascading over a sloping rock ledge into a murky green-brown pool, surrounded by dense foliage. Four shirtless men in swim trunks are present: one standing at the far-left rock edge, one seated on the wet slope with legs extended down the cascade, one standing on the upper ledge behind the seated man, and one standing mid-ledge facing the camera in patterned shorts.
visible_changes: Whitewater continuously tumbles over the rock face and the pool surface keeps rippling, changing its foam pattern frame to frame.
The seated man stays in his position on the slope throughout, with only minor posture/weight adjustments.
The upper-ledge man and the far-left man remain standing, largely static, with small shifts.
The mid-ledge man gradually shifts his stance and takes slow, careful steps downward along the wet rock toward the pool edge across the segment.
The framing drifts slightly rightward over time, so the far-left man becomes progressively more cropped at the left edge while the right rock bank and pool occupy more of the view.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the men arrived or will leave the waterfall, and any action before or after this excerpt.
The purpose of each person's pose or whether they interact off-camera.
uncertain_details: Whether the rightward framing change is a camera pan, a zoom-out, or both.
Whether the mid-ledge man is actively walking down or merely adjusting his footing.
The exact rock and water material properties.
